build_faces_decomposition_pca: build a faces decomposition using PCA with randomized SVD to extract eigenfaces from the Olivetti dataset
build_faces_decomposition_nmf: build a non-negative matrix factorization decomposition to extract non-negative components from face images
build_faces_decomposition_ica: build an independent component analysis decomposition to separate face subcomponents using FastICA
build_faces_decomposition_sparse_pca: build a sparse PCA decomposition using MiniBatchSparsePCA to extract sparse face components
build_faces_decomposition_dictionary_lea: build a dictionary learning decomposition using MiniBatchDictionaryLearning to find sparse face representations
